item.title: King Kong Banana Mod
item.description: This banana mod is a compact scene detail for King Kong and similar jungle-themed layouts where a small color accent makes the playfield feel more complete. It is designed as a quick visual upgrade, not a mechanical change.

item.title: King Kong Barrel with Banana Mod
item.description: This barrel with banana is a scene-building mod for King Kong and other jungle-themed machines where you want one stronger focal prop on the playfield. It adds visual story without requiring a larger rebuild.

item.title: Pinball Palm Tree Mod Set
item.description: This set is made for owners who want more depth on tropical and jungle playfields without changing core mechs or doing complex installs. It adds visual layering in areas that otherwise look flat or empty.

item.title: King Kong Gong Replacement
item.description: This replacement gong is made for Stern King Kong machines where the stock part feels visually light compared to the rest of the playfield. The goal is simple: a gong that looks more in scale with the machine theme and stays reliable over long-term use.

item.title: The Big Lebowski - Ramp mod
item.description:
Every Big Lebowski owner knows the pain: a great shot into the left ramp that sneaks past and drains anyway. This bowling pin ramp guard ends that. It sits where the ball escapes, quietly saving your best shots — and it looks like it was always meant to be part of the machine.

Printed in tough PETG at 100 mm tall, the pin doubles as a striking playfield detail: functional protection dressed up as pure theme. Mounting is straightforward with a standard playfield part change, so within minutes you’re back to shooting — this time with the ramp actually holding the balls it should.

item.title: The Big Lebowski - TBL Pinball Mod - Bowling Pins (Set of three pins)
item.description:
Your Big Lebowski playfield is full of nods to the movie — but the bowling alley is where the Dude lives. This set of three 3D printed bowling pins drops that world straight onto your machine, giving the bowling-themed shots the physical presence they deserve. It is the kind of detail visitors spot first, and the one that makes the whole theme click.

Each pin is printed in durable PETG at true pin proportions (60 mm tall) and sized to sit naturally alongside the existing playfield art. No brackets, no drilling, no disassembly: place them by hand wherever they look best and your TBL feels finished within a minute.
